name: Jal Hauj
benefit: - Grant for all farmers: 60% of the cost or max ₹90,000/-
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a native of Rajasthan.
1. The applicant should be a Farmer.
1. The farmer should have a minimum cultivable land of half a hectare on his name.
1. The applicant should be a source and means of irrigation.
1. Water tank size should be 100 cubic meters or one lakh liter capacity
